author: potuz
content:
Hello, I'd like to propose a couple of joint topics for ACDT. 

We need to find ways to deal with the case of payloads taking longer to execute. They will happen no matter what. I believe we can't deal with the bad situation of a payload taking longer than 6 seconds and less than 9, but at least we should  handle graciously some of Toni's attacks. 

1) We should be able to propose on empty no matter what, even if the EL is locked and does not give us a payload and even if we don't have any external bid, we need to put a dummy self-building bid. 
2) I believe moreover we should allow the proposer to propose even if the EL has returned SYNCING on our forkchoice head and we are finalizing. That is, the proposer in this case should try to attempt a payload reorg and propose on top of it's last valid head. The reason is that the EL just went optimistic due to not being able to process the latest blocks. The chain is finalizing well, the head was absolutely fine to propose before the last payload came, and the builder that provides the external bid has no forkchoice influence.
